name: Pu'er Lancang Ancient Tea Co., Ltd.
summary: Pu'er Lancang Ancient Tea Co., Ltd., founded in 1966 and headquartered in Pu'er, develops, makes and sells Pu'er tea in China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan under brands such as 1966, Tea Mama and Iland Tea. It sells through its own stores, distributor-run stores, hypermarkets and online stores. It was formerly Lancang Ancient Tea Co., Ltd., renamed in February 2018.
